falsifiable_hypothesis: The bounded raw target gain and the jackknife-SNR stabilized gain are complementary. Reliability is variance-like, so sqrt(reliability) is an amplitude confidence. Separately, if every one of the three held inner folds independently has a local B-residual optimum above the no-extra-gain point g=1, the direction of extra correction is unanimous and can be fully trusted without consulting any outer-held outcome.
gain_rule: For each outer partition compute patient-count-weighted amplitude theta, stable prior gain g0_j, bounded raw gain graw_j in [1,3], and K=3 bounded jackknife variance v_j exactly as in half_raw_jackknife_gain_hedge. Let delta_j=graw_j-g0_j and reliability r_j=delta_j^2/(delta_j^2+v_j), zero when numerator and denominator are both zero. Base raw weight alpha_j=0.5+0.5*sqrt(r_j). Also compute each held-fold local optimum glocal_k,j=-2*rB_k,j/theta_-k,j, defaulting to 1 when theta_-k,j is numerically zero. If glocal_k,j>1 for all three inner folds, set alpha_j=1; otherwise keep the base alpha_j. Final gain g_j=g0_j+alpha_j*(graw_j-g0_j). Apply qA=qA_loo_bagged and qB=qB_interpolated_jackknife-0.5*g_j*theta_j.
consensus_rule: Only all-three-inner-fold positive local gain consensus can trigger full raw gain. Two-of-three is insufficient. This rule is fixed before canonical replay.

task_contract.ab_rule: average losses across separately costed A/B orientations; never average predictions
